description: This file implements the ClientGrainLocator class, which is responsible for locating client grains within the Orleans runtime. It interacts with a local directory and manages resolving addresses for grain IDs, as well as handling cache invalidations and lookups.

classes.name: ClientGrainLocator
classes.description: Implements IGrainLocator to locate client grains using an in-memory distributed directory within Orleans.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up the address for a given grainId, parsing it and querying the local client directory.

methods.name: SelectAddress
methods.description: Selects an appropriate GrainAddress from a list of results, favoring local silo address if available or selecting randomly.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Throws an InvalidOperationException because explicit registration of client grains is not supported.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Throws an InvalidOperationException because explicit unregistration of client grains is not supported.

methods.name: ThrowNotClientGrainId
methods.description: Helper method to throw an exception when a GrainId is not recognized as a client grain id.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: No-op method for updating cache; placeholder for potential cache update logic.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: No-op method for invalidating cache by GrainId or GrainAddress.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to find a GrainAddress in local cache for a given GrainId, returning true if successful.
